extensionDescription.message: Sort mail into Important, Newsletters, and Social. Connect ChatGPT, OpenRouter, Gemini, or Grok to summarize a thread and draft a reply.

optionsLead.message: Rules sort obvious mail on this computer. A connected model is used when you ask, or when a message is hard to sort.

optionModelHelp.message: Leave this empty to use the provider’s default model.

optionAutoHelp.message: Apply tags when a message arrives in the inbox.

optionAiTitle.message: Ask the model when rules are unsure

optionAiHelp.message: Sends the sender, subject, and the start of the message. At most 40 messages an hour.

privacyNote.message: Rules run on this computer. The API key stays in this profile. The subject and a text excerpt are sent to the selected provider only when the model is called.

popupLead.message: When several messages are selected, those are sorted. Otherwise the current page of this folder is sorted, up to 50 messages. Tags show in the message list and in the quick filter.

composeLead.message: The reply uses the language of the mail unless your instruction says otherwise.

presetShorterInstruction.message: Make the current draft shorter and keep its meaning.

presetDeclineInstruction.message: Politely decline. Be brief and courteous.

defaultReplyInstruction.message: Write a helpful reply to the latest message.

defaultComposeInstruction.message: Write a reply based on the quoted message and this draft.

cappedNote.message: $COUNT$ left unsorted because the hourly limit was reached.

errorMissingKey.message: Add an API key for the selected provider.

errorNoJson.message: The model did not return JSON.

errorUnknownCategory.message: The model did not return a category.

errorSummaryEmpty.message: The thread has no readable text.

errorEmpty.message: The provider returned an empty answer.
